en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, form Hammad Bin Usman Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that
Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, the one who dug out the chasm for him<sup>saww</sup> was Abu Talha Al-Ansaryy’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from al-Halabiy who has said
the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Abu Talhah al-Ansariy prepared Lahad for the Messenger of Allah.’”
